notes.title: Patch notes for 0.2.2 - March 27, 2025
notes.content:
Some bug fixes and quality of life improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Anvil did not show craftable items
[*] Can now cancel in-progress items at crafting structures
[*] Shows crafting progress at crafting structures
[*] Other small bugs
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed issue where Anvil did not show craftable items

tags.feature: [*] Can now cancel in-progress items at crafting structures
[*] Shows crafting progress at crafting structures
